Fuller and Saudi Aramco Technologies announce commercialization of sustainable converge polyols |url=https://www.indianchemicalnews.com/technology/aether-hb-fuller-and-saudi-aramco-technologies-announce-commercialization-of-sustainable-converge-polyols-20212 |access-date=2024-10-19 |website=www.indianchemicalnews.com}}{{Cite news |date=2024-01-09 |title=Aether Industries, H B Fuller, Saudi Aramco jointly commercialise sustainable convergeo polyols tech |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/indl-goods/svs/chem-/-fertilisers/aether-industries-h-b-fuller-saudi-aramco-jointly-commercialise-sustainable-convergeo-polyols-tech/articleshow/106660561.cms?from=mdr |access-date=2024-10-19 |work=The Economic Times |issn=0013-0389}} Revenue operations began in Fiscal Year 2018.{{Cite web |title=Aether Industries commercialized manufacturing site 3 to manufacture speciality chemicals & intermediates |url=https://www.indianchemicalnews.com/chemical/aether-industries-commercialized-manufacturing-site-3-to-manufacture-speciality-chemicals-intermediates-16100 |access-date=2024-10-19 |website=www.indianchemicalnews.com}} In June 2022, Aether Industries went public with its [[Initial public offering|Initial Public Offering]] (IPO) on [[National Stock Exchange of India|Indian stock exchange]].{{Cite web |title=Aether Industries IPO Details - IPO Date, Price, GMP, Analysis & Review |url=https://www.chittorgarh.com/ipo/aether-industries-ipo/1257/#:~:text=Aether%20Industries%20IPO%20bidding%20started,to%20%E2%82%B9642%20per%20share. |access-date=2024-10-19 |website=www.chittorgarh.com |language=en-US}}{{Cite news |last=Nahar |first=Pawan |date=2022-06-03 |title=Aether Industries lists at 10% premium on stock exchanges |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/aether-industries-lists-at-10-premium-on-stock-exchanges/articleshow/91975768.cms?from=mdr |access-date=2024-10-19 |work=The Economic Times |issn=0013-0389}} Following its public debut, the company also conducted a Qualified Institutional Placement (QIP) in June 2023 to raise additional capital.{{Cite web |title=Aether Industries completes QIP to Raise Rs. 750 Cr |url=https://www.indianchemicalnews.com/general/aether-industries-completes-qip-to-raise-rs-750-cr-17944 |access-date=2024-10-19 |website=www.indianchemicalnews.com}}{{Cite web |date=2023-06-23 |title=Aether Industries raises Rs 750 crore through QIP issue — Goldman Sachs, SBI MF among key buyers - CNBC TV18 |url=https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/stocks/aether-industries-signs-exclusive-manufacturing-agreement-with-seqens-for-bio-based-products-19463893.htm |access-date=2024-10-19 |website=CNBCTV18 |language=en}}{{Cite web |date=2024-08-23 |title=Aether Industries signs exclusive manufacturing agreement with SEQENS for bio-based products - Manufacturing Today India |url=https://www.manufacturingtodayindia.com/aether-industries-signs-exclusive-manufacturing-agreement-with-seqens-for-bio-based-products |access-date=2024-10-19 |language=en-US}} ==Employees== As of 31 March 2024, Aether Industries' average employee age is 29 years.{{Cite web |title=Our focus is on organic expansion and building our own plants...: Dr. Aman Desai, Promoter and Whole Time Director, Aether Industries |url=https://www.indianchemicalnews.com/interviews/our-focus-is-on-organic-expansion-and-building-our-own-plants-dr-aman-desai-promoter-and-whole-time-director-aether-industries-231 |access-date=2024-10-19 |website=indianchemicalnews.com}} == References == {{reflist}} [[Category:Companies based in Surat]] [[Category:Indian companies established in 2013]] [[Category:Chemical companies established in 2013]] [[Category:Chemical companies of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]]
